description: Shell options: set -e/-u/-x/-f/-n/-a, pipefail and POSIX mode.

cases.name: option: errexit stops the script
cases.script: set -e; echo before; false; echo not-reached

cases.name: option: errexit ignores conditions
cases.script: set -e; if false; then :; fi; false || true; ! true; false && true; echo survived

cases.name: option: errexit in functions and subshells
cases.script: set -e; f() { false; echo in-f; }; f || echo f-failed; (false; echo in-sub); echo not-reached

cases.name: option: errexit and command substitution
cases.script: set -e; x=$(false; echo sub); echo "[$x]"; y=$(false); echo not-reached

cases.name: option: errexit in pipelines
cases.script: set -e; false | true; echo last-wins; set -o pipefail; false | true; echo not-reached

cases.name: option: errexit with local
cases.script: set -e; f() { local v=$(false); echo local-hides; }; f

cases.name: option: nounset and positionals
cases.script: set -u; f() { echo "${1-none}" "$#"; echo "$@"; }; f; echo ok

cases.name: option: xtrace
cases.script: set -x; x=1; echo "$x" done; f() { :; }; f arg; set +x; echo quiet

cases.name: option: noglob
cases.script: cd /tmp; touch g1; set -f; echo g*; set +f; echo g*

cases.name: option: pipefail status
cases.script: set -o pipefail; (exit 2) | (exit 3) | true; echo $?; true | (exit 4); echo $?

cases.name: option: set -o and +o
cases.script: set -o errexit; case $- in *e*) echo on;; esac; set +o errexit; case $- in *e*) echo still;; *) echo off;; esac

cases.name: option: posix mode
cases.script: set -o posix; echo ${POSIXLY_CORRECT-unset}; case $SHELLOPTS in *posix*) echo posix;; esac

cases.name: option: inherited by children
cases.script: set -e; bash -c 'case $- in *e*) echo child-e;; *) echo child-plain;; esac'

cases.name: option: shopt inherit_errexit
cases.script: set -e; shopt -s inherit_errexit; x=$(false; echo leaked); echo "[$x]"
